SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, to_char(T2.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') || ' - ' || to_char(T2.VDATE2,'yyyy-MM-dd') as proximalDeliveryDate , to_char(T2.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') || ' - ' || to_char(T2.MDATE2,'yyyy-MM-dd') as remoteDeliveryDate , T2.EXC_DEAL_TYPE tradeType, T2.CUR_PAIR ccyPair, T2.EXC_FXS_TERM_TYPE termType, T1.PS tradePs, T1.CCY tradeCcy, T1.ENTRUST_AMT tradeAmt, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH tradeCcyAvailablePosition, T2.COR_CCY contraCcy, T1.PRICE swapsPoint, T2.DEAL_CUR_ACCT tradeCcyAcct, T2.COR_CUR_ACCT contraCcyAcct, T1.REMARK remark, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T3.TRADER trader, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 inner join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 on T2.ENTRUST_ID=T1.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T3 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T3.ENTRUST_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
